subtitle: Waste Management System
jcr:title: Neptune S
jcr:description: The only constantly closed low-fluid waste management system on the market. With constantly closed SealShut technology, an easy hands-free docking process, and integrated specimen collection.

largeheadline.line2: Our goal is zero lost polyps**

text.text:
What does the “S” stand for? Safety? Suction? Streamlined specimen collection? Space saving design? All the above.

Neptune S was created to provide consistent, reliable suction and protect staff against unintentional exposures, spills, and lost specimen that happen under the current standard of care.

text_2110461559.text: The Neptune product line is the only constantly closed waste management system on the market. Neptune S offers an 8-liter capacity, 30% smaller footprint (compared to Neptune 3), and integrated specimen collection.

text_654000976.text: Zero lost polyps**, splashing, spilling and exposure observed when the constantly closed system was in use.1,2

text_copy.text: 8L of fluid capacity allows for quick turnover between cases.

text.text: Integrated polyp trap with a built-in backup basket to help prevent lost polyps.3

largeheadline_copy.line1:
Neptune S 
Our goal is zero* splashes and spills and zero* lost polyps**

text_copy_copy.text:
A) Waist level flat-top worksurface
 maximizes space to enable easy specimen transfer into the formalin jar.

B) Integrated specimen collection
 allows for a streamlined workflow.

C) Constantly closed system
 designed to reduce biohazardous fluid exposure during and after cases.

D) Illuminated worksurface
 for specimen transfer and charting. 

E) Illuminated manifold port
for easy visualization of the integrated polyp trap for specimen collection.

F) Smart equipment manager (SEM)
 A cloud-based application that provides real-time rover insights such as maintenance needs, rover location, total run time and more.

largeheadline_copy.line1:
Hands-free docking
and self-cleaning

text_654000976_copy.text: The Docking Station with Connectivity not only allows you to dispose of waste without exposure to hazardous materials but allows you gain data driven insights via Smart Equipment Management (SEM).

Smart Equipment Management (SEM) is an online could-based application designed to enhance the ownership experience for your Neptune S rovers.

It provides digital visibility to your data, offering reliability and efficiency for your staff. SEM supports proactive device maintenance, balanced product use, simplified service, and asset tracking.
